question.text: A USDINR futures contract value per lot is Rs. 83,000 (price = 83.00). If the margin requirement is 3%, what is the initial margin per lot?

explanation.text: The Logic: Applying the margin rate supplied in the stem: Margin = Contract value x Margin % = Rs. 83,000 x 3% = Rs. 2,490 per lot. Contract value is the basis on which margin is computed (p. 60). The Trap: The 3% rate is given in the stem; it is not a workbook-standard initial margin. Actual exchange initial margin uses an upfront/SPAN methodology (pp. 171-172). Note: Initial margin is a small fraction of contract value, which is the source of leverage risk in currency futures (p. 242).
